items.text:
‼️ Attackers hijacked over 4,800 #GitHub accounts to plant credential-stealing malware in repositories.

The stealer executed in at least 1,806 repos, harvesting CI and cloud credentials while attackers often erased traces of its activity.

Seen a wfx-docs branch? Check your repos: https://t.co/fwFKP1BKOx

items.author: TheHackersNews
items.text:
⚠️ Over 4,800 stolen GitHub accounts used to plant a CI secret stealer that ran in at least 1,806 repositories.

The malware targeted #GitHub secrets and cloud credentials. Attackers reverted malicious commits within a minute and usually deleted workflow logs.

Details → https://t.co/fwFKP1BKOx

‼️ BREAKING - Critical Apache HTTP/2 flaw could allow unauthenticated remote code execution.

CVE-2026-119618 affects versions 2.4.55–2.4.70 with HTTP/2 enabled.

CVSS 9.8. Fixed in 2.4.71, but some #Linux distributions still await patches.

Read more → https://t.co/pqK7XVed3I

Perplexity (@perplexity_ai)

We are publishing new research on our findings from red-teaming SPACE, our VM sandbox for Computer agents.

We gave 12 models two tasks: escape the VM to take a credential from the host, and bypass SPACE's network policy to reach a blocked URL.

We found that the standard Capture the Flag setup used in red-teaming can steer agents away from the security boundary being tested, and that security-specialized models don't guarantee better results.

https://t.co/Egh3x3uX4c

— https://nitter.gq/perplexity_ai/status/2120582674549203004
